entries.title: OB3M9
entries.creator: Giuseppe Zemba
entries.use: All three enemy types use this robot model. The original GLB is distributed as a provenance reference; the simplified GLB is loaded in the game.
entries.changes: Simplified from 18,756 to 8,036 triangles; reoriented, reposed and given original rigid-joint walking animation. Silver/ivory armor, shared PBR wear, status lights, wider role-specific proportions and larger elites are game modifications. No creator endorsement is implied.

entries.title: Concrete Floor Worn 02
entries.creator: Dimitrios Savva
entries.use: Poly Haven diffuse, normal and packed surface maps for the concrete yard.
entries.changes: Source images unchanged; tiled with adjusted tint and normal strength.

entries.title: Rusty Metal 02
entries.creator: Rob Tuytel
entries.use: Poly Haven diffuse, normal and packed surface maps for perimeter steel; shared wear on survivor armor and robot hulls.
entries.changes: Source images unchanged; material color, roughness and normal strength adjusted in the game.

entries.title: Factory Yard
entries.creator: Sergej Majboroda
entries.use: Poly Haven HDR environment for reflections and indirect lighting.
entries.changes: Unmodified HDR file; lighting intensity adjusted. Not used as a background image.

entries.title: Barrel 03
entries.creator: Serhii Khromov
entries.use: Poly Haven glTF model, geometry buffer and diffuse/normal/packed surface maps at the yard edges.
entries.changes: Source files unchanged; centered, reoriented from Y-up to Z-up and scaled to 1.8 world units high.

entries.title: Metal Plate
entries.creator: Rob Tuytel
entries.use: Poly Haven diffuse photograph on the HUD and reward panels.
entries.changes: Source image unchanged; darkened and tiled through CSS.

entries.title: Particle Pack 1.1
entries.creator: Kenney Vleugels / Kenney
entries.use: circle_05, flare_01 and smoke_01 provide sparks, flashes, explosion smoke and yard dust.
entries.changes: Unmodified PNGs; tinted, scaled and faded in the game. Pack filter-template credits: Indigo Ray, Craig Nisbet, Zoltan Erdokovy, Heliagon, ThreeDee, Killst4r and Tim2501.

entries.title: Game code, procedural artwork and sound
entries.creator: Man vs. Clankers project, developed with Codex
entries.use: Gameplay, UI layout, weapon diagrams, favicon, armored survivor, temporary robot loading fallback, orbiting drones, architectural geometry, safety paint, projectile shapes and rigid-part animations were created for this game. Sound effects are synthesized with Web Audio oscillators; there are no imported music or sound samples.

entries.title: Browser-provided fallbacks
entries.creator: The player’s browser and operating system
entries.use: Arial, sans-serif and monospace are fallback font names only. No files for these system fonts are redistributed.
